name: Craftsman 35084 / 35085
blurb: Oregon's narrow-kerf line for 35084 and 35085: 18″ bar, .325″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 72 drive links (M72).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Craftsman 35084 and 35085 under the Narrow Kerf heading with chain M72: 18″ bar, 72 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. M72 is Oregon's retail narrow-kerf code. The number 72 is the drive-link count, not the 72LPX family. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints M72 under the Narrow Kerf heading for Craftsman 35084 and 35085: 18″ bar, 72 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch
